pool_policy.note: no decode in S2: the committed dev300 pool is reused

implementation_notes: Prompt and score: model.chat itself builds the prompt (template internvl2_5 with its default system message; '<image>\n' + question with the image, the question alone and pixel_values None without it). Its generate call is wrapped to run one greedy step (max_new_tokens 1, do_sample False) with output_logits, and p = P(Yes + yes) / (P(Yes + yes) + P(No + no)) is read from the softmax of the raw logits at the first answer position; the token ids are tok.encode(w)[0] as in probe_existence.ask, recorded in score.json.

Image: the README's find_closest_aspect_ratio, dynamic_preprocess, build_transform and load_image are in xv_ef1.py without their comments; same_as_readme() compares them as code (Python AST) with the README of the snapshot, after checking its registered sha256, and refuses to run on any difference.

G0: A_within = knn_prior_eval.cell_auc and A_noimg = plan_f1.auroc on the N13 items, both imported unchanged (knn_prior_eval imports scikit-learn at module level, so the venv needs it); cells are round(k v) * 2 + g with k = 12 (N13) or 6 (N7_T0.5), as knn_prior_eval does.

CIs: one image resample, numpy default_rng(0) with B 2000 draws of the 300 dev images, is shared by every CI (the AUROC CIs of both pools and the CHAIR_i CI); the dev image without an N13 item is part of the resample. Per-cell item and pair counts are reported for both pools.

Readout (only on G0 PASS): upe_mbr.ktvic_views, utilities, pick, count_matched, compare, chair_counts and chair_delta unchanged, with EF1_V(c) = 2 sum p(o) / (|M(c)| + EG) over the caption's classes; before any endpoint it refuses unless the scorer reproduces P1_dev greedy's registered dev300 numbers (p1dev_reference_dev300: CIDEr-D, CHAIR_i, mentions per caption, P/R/F1 on ktvic5, panel F1).
Verdicts are computed: gate() for G0, prior_leak() for the kill, carried() for the carry rule, each from the registered thresholds in the prereg JSON.
Resume: the cache is append-only, keyed by (image_id, class); a restarted job scores only missing items. No result file is overwritten (a second one is written as _v2).

Outputs: /root/outputs/t3_1_s2_xvef1_g0/ (p_v.jsonl, score.json, g0.json, readout.json only on PASS, and t3_1_s2_xvef1_g0.sha256). The cache line goes to /root/outputs/sha256/t3_1_s2_xvef1_g0.sha256 and to the output directory's copy before analyse runs, and analyse refuses unless it is there; qrun.sh rewrites /root/outputs/sha256/<queued name>.sha256 after a job succeeds, so the job keeps its own copy, which analyse reads. Every result JSON records machine_id, git_head_sha and checkpoint_resume_hook_sha256 (checkpoint_resume_hook.provenance_metadata) and the prereg, addendum and script sha256. Only numbers, class names with their English phrases, pool indices and hashes are written: no caption, reference or OpenViIC text.

cases: check() on the committed files (all 29 registered inputs present locally and verified) and its refusal of an addendum that does not pin this script, a changed UPE constant, a changed class map, a changed code_at_head sha256, a changed input sha256 and a prereg the addendum does not pin
dev() on the real dev300 pools: the registered N13 and N7_T0.5 counts, every N7_T0.5 item an N13 item, and the refusal of a changed registered count
the cache: resume (only missing items are scored), the question with and without the '<image>\n' prefix, the item-set and [0, 1] checks, the sha256-before-AUROC rule, and _v2 instead of an overwrite
the README image code: identical to the registered README as code, refusal of an edited README and of a README with another sha256, tile counts 1, 3 and 13 from dynamic_preprocess

G0 on synthetic items whose positive rate rises with the cell: PASS for a score that sees the image; KILL at chance; KILL for a score that only knows the cell's prior (A_within is within-cell); KILL for a no-image score that knows the prior (A_noimg is marginal); g0() gates on N13, not N7_T0.5; the gate and prior-leak boundaries; each carry clause at its threshold and one step past it

the full dev readout on a synthetic pool (whitespace tokens; upe_mbr, object_prf, rl_reward and rescap.chair unchanged): CARRIED with an informative verifier, KILL (prior leak) when the no-image score equals the image score, NOT CARRIED with an uninformative one; the greedy reproduction check passes on exact values and refuses a changed F1 (3 decimals) and a changed CIDEr-D (1e-6)
